description: Source code for HttpAuthHandlerDigest class implementing Digest authentication handling, including nonce generation, challenge parsing, and credential assembly, based on RFC 2617.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest
classes.description: Handles HTTP Digest Authentication, including parsing challenges, generating credentials, and managing nonces.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::DynamicNonceGenerator
classes.description: Generates dynamic nonces, e.g., using random hex strings.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::Factory
classes.description: Creates instances of HttpAuthHandlerDigest, manages nonce generators.

methods.name: ParseChallenge
methods.description: Parses the WWW-Authenticate challenge header to extract parameters.

methods.name: ParseChallengeProperty
methods.description: Parses individual properties within the challenge header.

methods.name: GetRequestMethodAndPath
methods.description: Determines HTTP method and request path for credential assembly.

methods.name: AssembleResponseDigest
methods.description: Computes the response digest based on credentials and request info.

methods.name: AssembleCredentials
methods.description: Assembles the Authorization header value with computed digest.

methods.name: GenerateAuthTokenImpl
methods.description: Generates the Authorization token for a request.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallengeImpl
methods.description: Handles subsequent challenges, e.g., stale or realm changes.
